events.summary: Avacyn disappears and the geists and undead rise to torment Gavony.
events.quote: With the disappearance of Avacyn , the geists of the dead rose in bunches to torment the living.

events.summary: Mikaeus, his power waning, tries to calm the people and solve Avacyn's disappearance.
events.quote: Mikaeus frantically tried to solve the mystery of the disappearance of Avacyn

events.summary: Hanweir declares independence from Videns Parish and Gavony, then is mutated by Emrakul into an Eldrazi Ooze.
events.quote: the complete town was mutated by Emrakul into an Eldrazi Ooze
